_meta.basis: Approved annual marketing budget by GL account by month. Budget is NOT loaded into NetSuite - Budget vs. Actual (report -197) returns Budget Amount 0 for every account and at the subsidiary grand-total line. This file is the only budget source.

66212.0002.note: Agency fees are 20% of combined Google + Meta spend, per cells B5:M5 of the source workbook. This is not a fixed line: any increase in Google or Meta spend carries a 20% agency surcharge. Every budget ask involving paid media must be priced with it.

unbudgeted_actuals.note: Accounts carrying 2026 actuals with no approved budget line. Every dollar must still appear in the budget-vs-actual table; these become explicit rows rather than being dropped, which is how v1's table under-reported.

targets.set_by: Jules, 2026-09-04; basis confirmed as TOTAL revenue by Jules 2026-09-05
targets.definition: Grow 2026 total NET revenue (subsidiary 2, all customers, categories 2 and 14 excluded) 19% over 2025 total NET revenue.
targets.prior_year_basis_note: FY2025 total NET revenue = alt_all_transacting_net in data/snapshots/2026-08/acquisition_vintage.json (trandate in 2025, every transacting account, credits and refunds deducted). Replace with the sum of the twelve 2025 revenue_total monthly snapshots once ingested; the two must agree to the cent.
targets.series: revenue_total (data/snapshots/YYYY-MM/revenue_total.json; src/ingest/queries/revenue_total_monthly.sql). Until 2026 monthly snapshots exist the pages show the target and mark pace as pending; nothing is estimated in its place.

marketing_frame.name: new-customer revenue (M1, and revenue to date)
marketing_frame.why: The target is a company figure. Marketing's measurable contribution is the revenue of the customers it acquires, shown on the frozen M1 basis and on the revenue-to-date basis, always with maturity. Neither is the target and neither is graded as if it were.

superseded_2026_09_05.note: Set 2026-09-04 on the reading that 19% applied to new-customer M1 revenue. Jules confirmed 2026-09-05 that leadership means total revenue. Kept for the record; not used.
